svg.text: PLANT ROOM 2 – OLYMPIC POOL · PLUMBED PLAN, 22 × 14 m (prompt 033)
POOL DOOR (deck level, onto the landing)
EAST · POWER AND CONTROL; THE POOL DOOR
COMMON HEADERS: INLET · OUTLET · BACKWASH (each filter on its five-valve face pipework)
